cases.assertion: A logged-in user registers an ES256 discoverable credential using a fresh challenge for that session. Only the owner can list or delete it, and deleting the final available method is denied.
A verified discoverable assertion finds the active account and uses the existing session and remember-me/2FA lifecycle, including revoked-session and inactive-account protections.
Missing/expired/replayed or another-session challenges, invalid origin, incorrect RP ID, invalid signature, missing UV, user-handle mismatch and a stale counter fail without a session.
